_about: Example settings for a fictional household (the Rivera household: two adults, a teenager away at a summer program, a dog). Copy this file to config.json and change it for your own household. Keys that start with an underscore are comments; build_data.py ignores them. Every regex is a JavaScript and Python compatible pattern, matched without regard to case.
_about_title: Shown as the page heading and the browser tab title.
title: The Rivera household ledger
_about_inputs: Input files, relative to this config file. Subscriptions and orders are optional; they are skipped when the file is missing.
_about_lastMonthPartial: true marks the last month as partial (shown faded, left out of averages). Leave it out to let the builder decide from the last transaction date.
_about_ignoreCategories: Tiller categories that are not spending or income: transfers between your own accounts and card payments.
_about_incomeRules: Money in (positive amounts). Each rule is [regex, source]; the regex is tested against 'Description | Category'. The first match names the income source. Anything else positive is counted under refundSource.
_about_categoryMap: Rename Tiller categories to the page's categories: {tiller name: page name}.
_about_catFix: For spending left in 'Other' or with no category: [regex on vendor, category].
_about_aliasRules: Clean vendor names in the builder: [regex on the description, clean name]. Several spellings can point at one name to merge them.
_about_vendorRules: [regex on vendor, tags to add (comma separated, may be empty), category to force (may be empty)].
_about_increaseSplit: Optional. Split a vendor's price rise into its own line from a month on: the part above base goes to label.
_about_payrollSource: The income source that is smoothed to a flat monthly amount (Options tab) and taxed at taxRate percent, for pay with no tax withheld. Leave empty for none.
_about_oneoffIncome: One-time money in that is not in the transactions: {name: {YYYY-MM: amount}}. It is drawn apart so it does not hide the run rate.
_about_oneoffTaxable: Names from oneoffIncome that also get the tax set-aside. oneoffNetOfCenter (optional) subtracts that center's excluded costs first.
_about_groups: Groups for the overview charts: each has a name, its page categories and a color. Categories not in any group fall into 'Other'.
_about_categoryNames: Default display names, {category: name}. Editable later on the Options tab.
_about_feeCategory: The category that holds card interest and fees. fees.avoidable and fees.chosen are regexes on the fee's vendor name; interestAvoidableFrom (YYYY-MM, optional) counts interest as avoidable only from that month.
_about_foodCategories: Categories summed in the Food tile on the overview.
_about_centers: Cost and profit centers: a second way to slice spending. id starts with #. match (optional regex on vendor) adds vendors; vendors tagged with the id are added too. hidden: true keeps a center off until 'Show hidden centers' is ticked.

centers.name: #HomeCare (home maintenance)
centers.note: Everything in Home & yard and Services, plus anything tagged #HomeCare.

centers.name: #Dog
centers.note: Food, vet and insurance for the dog.

centers.name: #Sam (summer program)
centers.note: The summer program, travel to it and anything tagged #Sam.

centers.name: Receivable: work expenses
centers.note: Work software the employer pays back. Left out of household spending.

centers.name: #Legal
centers.note: For reference only: left out of every total on this page.

centers.name: #Gifts
centers.note: Tag gift orders #Gifts on the Vendors tab.

_about_centerRules: Default center for a whole category, {category: #center}. Editable later on the Options tab.
_about_exclude: Spending to leave out of every total and show in a center instead. match is a regex on vendor; receivable true means it is owed back to you. Optional: category (only that category), before / after (YYYY-MM, only months before or from then), countAsDebt (true adds it back to debt cost when 'True debt cost' is on).
_about_hobbies: Hobby cards: id is also the vendor tag that adds a vendor (and -id removes it); re is a regex on vendor; who is a default owner the reader can change.
_about_dependent: Optional tab for one dependent. Leave out to hide the tab. matchRegex adds charges by vendor between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD); items adds rows by hand; tripShare gives the dependent a share of a family trip; tag (default: label in lower case) on a vendor adds all its charges.

dependent.label: Sam
dependent.note: Sam's summer program in 2026: tuition, the campus store and the bus there and back.

items.why: Given in cash, added by hand

tripShare.why: a quarter of the family rail trip

leftOut.label: meals at the program, not tracked

_about_travel: travelCategory is the Tiller category for trips. Vendors in a place marked work, and vendors matching travelGenericRegex in workMonths, become 'Travel: work'; the rest become 'Travel: personal'. Leave workMonths empty and mark no place as work to keep one Travel category.
_about_places: Travel map. keys are vendor names tied to the place (after aliases); months are YYYY-MM. Optional: home (the origin of the trip lines), work, planned, route (part of the route line, no line from home). Leave out places to hide the tab.
_about_route: Optional dashed route line, a list of [lon, lat]. routeMonth (YYYY-MM) is when it appears on the timeline.
_about_map: mapCenter [lon, lat] and mapZoom set the first view. mapData (optional) points at your own copies of the us-atlas and world-atlas files; by default the page tries local files, then the public CDN.
_about_shopping: Optional Shopping tab for one online store. vendorRegex picks its charges; excludeRegex drops digital or non-shopping lines. orderLookupUrl (optional) builds a link per order, {q} is replaced by the item name. kinds sort orders by item text: [kind, regex]. Leave out to hide the tab.
_about_orderKinds: Set the kind of one order by its item text: {item: kind}.
_about_orderTags: Put orders into a center: [regex on item, #center]. The order takes its matched charge.
_about_vendorNotes: A short note shown in a vendor's hover card: {vendor: note}.

vendorNotes.CloudDesk Pro: Work software; the employer pays it back each quarter.

_about_balances: Optional balances for the Cash in and out tab: checking and cards are lists of [name, amount].
_about_known: Known future items for the 12-month projection: name, amount (negative is money out), month (YYYY-MM), uncertain (starts switched off).
_about_subscriptions: subscriptionCategories (optional) limits the automatic subscription finder to these categories; subsStreamingRegex picks the 'streaming and apps' tile.
_about_notes: Optional page text: cashflow (under the cash chart), leftOut (Notes tab), shopping (under the shopping chart).

notes.cashflow: Money in is what lands in linked accounts; the two paychecks are the base, contract pay comes and goes.
notes.leftOut: Left out everywhere: transfers between our own accounts and card payments. Not linked: the savings account.

_about_source: One line on where the data came from, shown on the Notes tab.
source: Built from a synthetic Tiller-style export (sample_transactions.csv) for a fictional household.
